service: Standard bare PCB fabrication; self assembly or supplied JLCPCB assembly inputs
stackup: Supplier standard four-layer FR-4; no custom dielectric construction
esp32_centre_joint: Omitted: masked centre land, no thermal hole array, no centre paste; pin 9 remains soldered to GND
keyboard: Delivered attached; preserve functional bridge and mouse bites
status: Engineering prototype: current display/USB corrections, JST-SH J2 and J6 battery wire solder pads; revised hardware requires bench validation and supplier CAM/placement review
routing_review: All trace ends and junctions independently audited; 45-degree routing, full land entries, no exposed sub-0.20 mm segments

battery_connector.entry: Side entry, opening toward left board edge (-X), cable parallel to PCB
battery_connector.substitution: No PH, ZH, or top-entry SH substitute. Previous PH battery plug is incompatible.
battery_connector.peak_current_assumption: User accepts intermittent excursions above 1 A for this prototype; no current limiter or operating restriction added. This does not constitute a manufacturer pulse rating.

battery_solder_pads.pin_1: VBAT positive, right pad at (56.1,96.0) mm
battery_solder_pads.assembly: Hand solder only; no paste, BOM or placement entry
battery_solder_pads.connection: Parallel with J2; use one battery connection at a time
